name: io.github.tethlo/mcp-for-healthchecks-io
title: Tethlo MCP server for Healthchecks.io (unofficial demo)
description: Unofficial demo. Healthchecks.io for AI agents: cron monitors, failures, pause, create checks.

environmentVariables.name: HEALTHCHECKS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Healthchecks.io project API key (Project Settings > API Access). Read-only keys allow only the read tools.

environmentVariables.name: HEALTHCHECKS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: a self-hosted Healthchecks instance. Default: https://healthchecks.io
